what: On a night-shift day the plan card says 'Night shift: rest…', but the hero still says 'One composed session · about 24 minutes' with 'Start the Round'. Tapping Start preselects 'Five step-by-step gases · 8 min', because roundCap() returns 0 and presetLegs always keeps the first leg. Two cards give opposite advice.
evidence: Served on localhost, G.tok set, G.planDays[today]={shift:{code:'N',overnight:true}}: plan '0/1 · about 3 min · night shift', hero unchanged, builder checked 000100, 'Start · 8 min'. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-night-today.png
fix: When slotFor(today())==='tough': change the hero to 'Night shift · Buffer rests today', make the button secondary ('Do a Round anyway'), and have presetLegs(cat,0) return [] (or a single 'Five-second read' leg) so the builder opens empty. Do the same light-touch copy for 'postnight'.

what: A brand-new user gets no welcome and no orientation. Lesson 1 ('How you will learn blood gases · Start here') is the 6th block down, under the Round, the plan, the quick tiles, the Gas of the day, the hook and the Citrus card. The Round, the first thing offered, is aimed at someone who already reads gases: 'Concept of the day: Carbonic anhydrase' and 'Five step-by-step gases' at the default level 4 (DEF2.lvl:4, Full read).
evidence: localStorage.clear(), 390×844: order hero → plan → quick → gotd → hook → citrus → Next lesson tile. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png. e1.js DEF2 lvl:4.
fix: When Object.keys(S.done).length===0 && !S.read: replace the hero with a 'Start here' card (lesson 1 + a 2-line description of Today/Round/plan + a units choice mmHg/kPa), and hide or collapse the mastery grid and the Gas of the day ('after your first lesson'). Consider DEF2.lvl:1 or asking 'Have you read gases before?' on first open.

what: 'Next' marks the lesson done (S.done, +15 XP) even when no question has been answered. The lesson then shows as ticked in the module list and counts in 'n of 98 lessons'. 'Continue' then skips it, so the learner can never be sent back to the retrieval questions. This contradicts the 'Retrieve it before you move on' heading and the retrieval-practice claim on the learn lesson.
evidence: Fresh state: openLesson('dalton'), click Next without answering → S.done.dalton = 1, S.qs.dalton undefined; Learn header reads '2 of 98 lessons'.
fix: Mark a lesson done only when all of its questions have been answered (as the toast logic already does). If Next is pressed with questions unanswered, show 'Read' (a separate S.read[l.id] flag) and give the module list a half-filled tick, or ask 'Skip the 5 questions?'.

what: In Quiet mode, crossing an XP level threshold still fires confetti() and shows the toast 'Mastery updated' (rewritten from 'Level up: …'). Mastery (pattern boxes) has nothing to do with XP, so the toast is false and appears at random moments. The confetti breaks the 'quiet game feel' roadmap decision.
evidence: S.quiet=true; S.xp=145; addXP(10) → #confetti canvas exists and toast 'Mastery updated'.
fix: In addXP: if(after>before&&S.quiet===false){toast(...);confetti();}. Drop the 'Level up → Mastery updated' rewrite in toast().

what: Game words remain on the Learn screen in Quiet mode: the subtitle 'Each module ends in a boss fight.' (lowercase is not in MAP) and the chip 'BOSS ✓' on passed modules.
evidence: Quiet default, any state with a module check passed → go('learn'): text scan finds 'From the proton to the bedside. Each module ends in a boss fight.' and 'BOSS ✓'.
fix: Write Quiet-aware strings at source: ui1.js:159 S.quiet!==false?'Each module ends in a module check.':'…boss fight.'; ui1.js:163 chip text S.quiet!==false?'CHECK ✓':'BOSS ✓'. Or add case-insensitive MAP entries /boss fight/gi and /BOSS ✓/.

what: The generic action sheet closes on Escape, but it does not move focus into the sheet. It has no aria-modal, no trap and no focus return. Escape uses stopPropagation, which does not stop the other document-level keydown listeners (the session listener would also see the Escape). There is no shared modal helper, so each of the four sheets in the app handles keyboard differently.
evidence: kb3.py: sheet("Test",...) -> focus stays on the lesson button behind the sheet. aria-modal = null.
fix: Add one helper, openModal(sc,{opener,initial}), in ui1.js. It should set role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; focus the initial element; trap Tab; close on Escape (use stopImmediatePropagation, and register with capture:true); set inert on main, header and #roundbar; and on close remove inert and opener.focus(). Use it in sheet(), openRoundBuilder(), saveSheet() and ocrSheet().

what: Answering a lesson question disables all of its options, including the focused one, so focus drops to <body>. The .why feedback is unhidden but not announced. Right and wrong are shown only by red and green colour on the disabled buttons, whose kbd letters stay A–D.
evidence: chat.py: openLesson("ph"), Enter on the first option -> activeElement BODY. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T27-lesson-answered.png (A red, C green, no text marker on either option).
fix: Before disabling, move focus to the .why paragraph (tabindex=-1). Give .why role="status". Change the kbd to ✓ or ✗ on the right and wrong options, as sessions already do, and add a visually hidden "(correct)" / "(your answer)" to their accessible names.

what: Changing view never moves focus or announces anything. The <title> stays "Buffer Blood Gas Trainer" on every view. When the activating button is replaced (Labs tiles, Today tiles, Practice tiles, back crumbs), focus falls to <body>, and the next Tab restarts at the brand button, which is 7 stops before the content. Screen-reader users are not told that the page changed.
evidence: kb.py: Enter on the Learn tab -> focus stays on the tab, and nothing is announced. Enter on the Practice "Step by step" tile -> BODY.
fix: At the end of go(): set document.title = "<view title> · Buffer"; focus the view's h1 (h1.tabIndex=-1; h1.focus({preventScroll:true})), or the first heading if there is no h1, unless the view was opened by a bottom-tab press (then keep focus on the tab and announce the view name in a polite live region).

where: Today · Round card vs Round builder (ui5 roundCap / presetLegs)
what: The Round card promises 'One composed session · about 24 minutes' with 6 legs. 'Start the Round' opens a builder with only 3 legs ticked ('Start · 14 min'), because roundCap() defaults to 15. Today's plan says 'The Round 25 min' and the 'How you will learn' lesson says about 25 minutes. After those 3 legs the card says 'Round complete. Done for today' and lists all 7 legs, including the 4 that were never done, with no ticks.
evidence: Fresh start at 1280×800 → Start the Round. Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round1.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-finish.png
fix: Pick one default (25 min on a free day). Make the card list exactly what the builder preselects, with the same total. On completion, tick the legs done and grey the ones skipped ('3 of 6 legs').

where: Today on phone · layout for shift use
what: On a phone, Today has no quick way to read a gas above the fold. The Round card and Today's plan fill the first screen. 'Interpret' is a tile about one screen down, or it takes Labs → Gas interpreter. On shift, the most common job is the one hardest to reach.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-phone-today.png (390×844).
fix: Add a persistent 'Read a gas' action: a floating button on every view at phone width, or a first row on Today. Long-press could open the venous-preset interpreter.

what: There is no first-run setup. A new user is not asked for an exam goal, units, a shift pattern or a daily goal (15 gases is preset). The first suggestion is 'Concept of the day: Carbonic anhydrase'. The Gas of the day is an 80-year-old with HAGMA + NAGMA and albumin 22. The 'Start here' lesson sits below the fold. The Round starts with compensation sums before any lesson has taught Winter's.
evidence: localStorage.clear() → reload at 1280×800. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-firstrun.png
fix: Add a 3-screen first run: (1) exams (MRCEM Primary or SBA, USMLE Step 1 or 2), (2) units and altitude (Riyadh/Abha are already offered), (3) shift pattern or daily minutes. Then make the first Round 'Start here' + the six-step read + 3 guided gases, and keep Gas of the day at level ≤ 2 until 5 lessons are done.

what: During a second Round on the same day, the hero says 'ROUND COMPLETE · Done for today. Anything else is a bonus.' while also showing 'Continue the Round', Stop and the in-progress leg list. The doneToday check wins over inRound.
evidence: Finish a Round, then 'Another Round' → Start → go('today'). Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-today-secondround-phone.png
fix: Check inRound first: tag 'Round in progress', h2 'Leg i of n · <current label>'. Use doneToday only when !inRound (maybe 'Bonus Round in progress').

what: After a Round is complete, the hero lists today's full default plan (all 6–8 legs with minutes), not the legs actually done. It looks like a to-do list that still needs doing.
evidence: Finish a 3-leg Round → hero shows Concept/Gym/Estimates/Steps/Shift/Teach with min. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-today-rounddone-phone.png
fix: Store the finished legs (S.lastRoundLegs) and show them ticked with the real time, or collapse the hero to one line: 'Round done · 3 legs · 12 min · +40'.

what: In a Round in progress, the hero leg list marks done legs but not the current one, and none of the rows can be tapped. You cannot jump to or skip a specific leg from Today.
evidence: Round leg 1 of 3: no .cur class; li elements are not buttons.
fix: Add class 'cur' (accent left border) to li i===ROUND.i, and make each future leg a button that sets ROUND.i and calls roundGo (with confirm).

what: The 'Step by step' tile says '10 gases' regardless of the Gases per session setting (S.sessLen 5/10/20).
evidence: S.sessLen=5 → tile still '10 gases, marked step by step'.
fix: Use S.sessLen in the tile text, as MODS_META does on Practice.

what: The Gas of the day card does not change after you have read it (S.ui.gotd is set in ui2.js but never read), and it is not on Today's plan. 'Just show me' cannot be hidden again and gives only the label, the cause and the compensation, with no anion gap or Δ ratio reasoning for a HAGMA + NAGMA gas.
evidence: Set S.ui.gotd=today() → card unchanged. Show → 'HAGMA + NAGMA · Diarrhoea with AKI and dehydration. Appropriate respiratory compensation.'
fix: When S.ui.gotd===today(), show '✓ Read today · your score' and change the button to 'Review it'. Make 'Just show me' a toggle and include the gap (corrected) and Δ ratio lines from g.o.steps. Optionally add 'Gas of the day' as a 2-min plan item.

what: Answers are not kept. Reopening a lesson shows all five questions unanswered, with no 'last time 4/5' or note of which ones were missed. S.qs only stores aggregate counts, so a learner coming back to revise cannot see what they got wrong.
evidence: Answer all of the hh questions, then openLesson('hh') again: 0 options are disabled.
fix: Store per-question results in S.qs[l.id].last=[true,false,…] and show a 'Last time 4/5 · retry missed' chip above Check yourself. Optionally show the missed ones first.

what: No way to keep the natural order of ordinal options (types, numbers). Also affects numeric options such as ventchg q4 'About 7 / 25 / 20 / 15' and odc q2 mmHg values, which read better ascending.
evidence: renderLesson uses shuffle(it[1]...) unconditionally.
fix: Honour a fixed-order flag; or sort options when all are numbers/ordinals.

where: worked gas card (row() for venous samples)
what: Venous worked gases (dka, diarr) show arterial reference ranges (PvCO₂ 35–45, pH 7.35–7.45, HCO₃⁻ 22–26) and flag PvCO₂ 17 'L' against them.
evidence: ui1.js:74 row(ven?'PvCO₂':'PaCO₂',…,rp(35,45)); rendered dka worked gas.
fix: For ven samples use venous ranges (pH 7.31–7.41, PvCO₂ 41–51, HCO₃⁻ 23–29) or label the column 'arterial ref'.

where: copyText silent failure (Copy line, Copy all)
what: When the clipboard is blocked (an http preview or an embedded webview), 'Copy line' and 'Copy all' fail with no message. The button label stays the same.
evidence: s9.py with no clipboard: clicking #wkCopy left the label 'Copy line' and showed no toast.
fix: In copyText, when it fails, show toast('Clipboard blocked: select the text and copy it') and select a read-only textarea with the text, or fall back to document.execCommand('copy').

what: There is no theme-change event, so canvas models cannot redraw with the new tokens (see the e3.js finding).
evidence: grep shows no theme event; applyTheme only sets attributes.
fix: At the end of applyTheme(): dispatchEvent(new Event('buffer:theme')).

where: Learn eyebrow '… boss badges' → Quiet 'module checks'
what: The count is Object.keys(S.badges).length, so it includes Native reader, Week of gases, Ten Rounds and Automatic. Quiet mode then calls them all 'module checks'. With one badge it reads '1 module checks'.
evidence: S.badges={m-chem, native} → '0 of 98 lessons · 2 module checks'; with only m-chem → '1 module checks'.
fix: Count only keys starting with 'm-' and pluralise: n+' module check'+(n===1?'':'s')+' passed'. Fix the MAP entry /boss badges?/ to keep the singular.

what: Game words show for up to about 120 ms before the walker replaces them, on every render and every hint bubble. 'Boss fight' briefly flashes on screen before it becomes 'Module check', and the rewriting costs a full-document TreeWalker pass after every mutation.
evidence: The hold test captured the first bubble text before the replacement; the source uses setTimeout(walk,120).
fix: Replace the DOM walker with a word function at source (gw('Boss fight') → 'Module check' in Quiet) used by ui1, ui2, ui5 and kit. Keep the walker only as a safety net.

where: Quiet mode MAP (game words → plain words)
what: Quiet mode leaks game words. The Learn header says 'Each module ends in a boss fight.' (MAP only matches the capitalised 'Boss fight'). The Practice 'Final check' card says 'Ten right earns the Native reader badge.'
evidence: S.quiet=true; go('learn') shows 'From the proton to the bedside. Each module ends in a boss fight.' (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-learn-quiet-True.png). go('practice') shows '…Ten right earns the Native reader badge.'
fix: Add /boss fight/gi → 'module check' and /Ten right earns the Native reader badge\./ → 'Ten right passes the final check.' to MAP. Better still, render quiet text at source with a qw('Boss fight','Module check') helper rather than rewriting the DOM.

what: The streak chip is read as "fire 0" (emoji plus a number). Its title "Day streak" is not used by screen readers on a span. The session bar count "0 ✓" is read as "0 check mark". The "← Labs" style crumbs are read as "left arrow Labs" (polish).
evidence: aria snapshot of today: "text: 🔥 0".
fix: Streak: el.setAttribute("role","img") with aria-label="Streak: N days", or a visually hidden "Day streak:" and aria-hidden on the emoji. Session bar: <span aria-label="N correct">. Crumb arrows: wrap them in <span aria-hidden="true">.

where: RENDER.today Gas of the day prompt
what: 'Read it in your head first: pH, partner, proof, the rest.' uses a mnemonic that appears only as one lesson hook (c3.js line 366). It does not match the six-step read the app teaches on Learn (Real? · pH · System · Compensation · Gaps · Oxygen), and it skips the consistency check.
evidence: ui1.js line 137 vs METHOD in ui1.js line 155.
fix: Use the app's method: 'Read it in your head first: real? · pH · system · compensation · gaps · oxygen.'

what: 'One composed session · about 24 minutes': 'composed' is jargon. On phones the line wraps with '·' at the start of the second line.
evidence: Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png (line 2 starts with '· about 24 minutes').
fix: 'Today's Round · about 24 min' as the h2, or put the minutes in the eyebrow ('TODAY'S ROUND · 24 MIN') with an h2 like 'Six short legs, one sitting'. Use a non-breaking space before '·'.

what: 'Late shift.' between 00:00 and 04:59 assumes work. With Citrus shift data the app knows whether the user is on a night shift.
evidence: Clock 02:00 → 'Late shift.'
fix: Use 'Up late.' by default, and 'Night shift.' only when slotFor(today())==='tough'. Optionally add the name of today's shift from Citrus to the eyebrow.

what: 'Compensation · 50% over your last attempts.' does not say how many attempts; stepAcc uses the last up to 20.
evidence: Seeded comp h length 10 → '50% over your last attempts'.
fix: 'Compensation · 5 of your last 10 right.' using the h slice.

what: In quiet mode (the default) the eyebrow reads '0 module checks' and the button reads 'Module check', but the subtitle still says 'Each module ends in a boss fight.' The Quiet-mode MAP only matches 'Boss fight' with a capital B.
evidence: Fresh state, Learn tab (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T02-modlist-desk.png).
fix: Add [/boss fight/g,'module check'] to the Quiet MAP, or write the subtitle as 'Each module ends in a check.'

what: Modules are numbered from 00 ('Module 0 · Start here'), and the lesson header shows its position in the whole course ('8 / 98') with a progress bar that tracks position, not completion. Readers take '8 / 98' as progress.
evidence: Lesson stewartx crumbs: 'Module 1 · Chemistry of acids and buffers · 8 / 98'.
fix: Show 'Lesson 7 of 7 in this module' and colour the bar by S.done for the module. Either number modules from 1 or label Start here 'Intro' with no number.

what: The count is wrong in both modes: '1 module checks' (quiet) and '1 boss badges' (game) have no singular. It also counts every key in S.badges, not just module badges.
evidence: S.badges={b1:1}: the Learn eyebrow reads '0 OF 98 LESSONS · 1 MODULE CHECKS'.
fix: Use n+' module check'+(n===1?'':'s') and count only badge ids that belong to modules.

what: Quiet mode rewrites text 120 ms after each render, so game words ('Boss fight', '+15 XP') flash briefly on every re-render.
evidence: See the walk() setTimeout(…,120) in ui1.js.
fix: Run walk() synchronously at the end of go()/RENDER, or (as above) generate quiet text at source.

where: Today: next-lesson tile and other card buttons
what: Card buttons put the whole description into the accessible name. For example, the next-lesson tile reads "01 Next lesson · Start here How you will learn blood gases Understand the mechanism once, drill one fixed read … Every part of the app ma…". Labs tiles and Practice tiles are the same. This makes the controls slow to skim.
evidence: snap-today.txt and snap-labs.txt.
fix: Name each button with its title only (aria-labelledby pointing at the <b> or h3), and point aria-describedby at the description.

what: 'One composed session · about 24 minutes' with text-wrap:balance breaks before the middle dot, so line 2 starts with '· about 24 minutes'.
evidence: 390×844 and 360×640. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-today-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Use a non-breaking space before the dot ('session\u00a0· about…') or put the duration on its own line as a small subtitle.

what: Back from any tab other than Today leaves the app, because tab switches use replaceState. On Android it is normal for Back to go to Home first.
evidence: #today → Learn tab → Back → about:blank.
fix: When leaving Today for a top-level tab, pushState once (as SUBNAV does), so Back from Learn/Labs/Practice/Progress returns to Today, and only Back on Today exits.

what: 15 'new' tiles take more than half the phone screen for a new user and carry no information until something has been read.
evidence: First-run phone shot: grid from y≈1400 to 2900 px of 2921.
fix: For new users show a single line ('15 patterns · read your first gas to start the map'). Collapse the grid behind 'Show all' on phones.

what: The Gas of the day has no 'streak' or comparison; 'the same gas for everyone' is only true within one time zone, because the seed is the local day.
evidence: withSeed(dayNum()*7919).
fix: Show your own past Gas-of-the-day results (last 7 days ✓/✗) and say 'the same gas for every Buffer user today' only if you seed by UTC date.

what: Retrieval: missed questions are stored (S.qmiss) but never come back inside the Learn tab.
evidence: S.qmiss is written in renderLesson and used only for Yuzu packs (ui9).
fix: Add a 'Retry missed (n)' button on the module row and the lesson, and feed missed lesson questions into the Round's spaced queue.

what: The Start here 'module check' is five questions about learning science. Losing it feels odd, and it awards a boss badge for meta content.
evidence: Learn → Start here → Module check (5 questions in 3 min).
fix: Hide the module check for 'start' (require pool ≥ 4 and m.id !== 'start'), or replace it with a 'how the six-step read works' quiz.

what: Companion to the stem idea: the worked gas card has no place for a stem.
evidence: ui1.js renderLesson builds lEx from slip(c) only.
fix:
If l.ex.stem exists, render '

'+esc(stem)+'

' before the slip.

what: Lesson text is mmHg only even when Settings units = kPa; MRCEM uses kPa.
evidence: Set S.units='kPa' -> lesson bodies are unchanged.
fix: Wrap numbers in <span data-mmhg=..> and convert on render, or show '(x kPa)' inline everywhere.

what: The worked gas has no inline reading; the teaching trap (asthma 'normal' gas = life-threatening; asa mixed disorder) is only visible after 'Open in the Interpreter'.
evidence: Reviewer suggestion (senior EM).
fix: Add a one-line caption per lesson (new lesson field e.g. exNote) under the card: 'Interpreter calls this normal acid–base; in a severe attack it is life-threatening.'

what: One slip resets a pattern from stage 5 to 0, so mastery % falls sharply (one HAGMA miss turns 13% into 7%). This is discouraging and noisy for a well-known pattern.
evidence: ui2.js:161 else st.box=0.
fix: Drop two stages on a miss (Math.max(0,box-2)) or use a graded SM-2-style ease. Show a 'mastery trend' line.

what: One announce(msg) helper used everywhere would fix most of the silent feedback in one change.
evidence: The speed drill already uses role=status on #spFb, which works. The other areas have no live region.
fix: Add a visually hidden <div id="sr" aria-live="polite"> in shell.html and a function announce(t){sr.textContent="";setTimeout(()=>sr.textContent=t,30)}. Call it from answerQ, answerGym, answerFit, reflexAnswer, the lesson .opt handler, case answers, sim results, runInterp, toasts, view changes and round-leg changes.

what: (2) Shift mode for the phone. Reading a gas on shift needs: one tap to open, a venous default you can remember, the fields in printout order with the numeric keypad, the result pinned on top, then Save with tag.
evidence: Learner session, 13/11/2026
fix: Add a 'Shift' toggle (or auto-detect phone width plus night-shift slot) that opens straight into the interpreter with a sticky result bar, hides study cards and remembers the last sample type.

where: Today · Gas of the day difficulty
what: (9) The Gas of the day is the same for everyone, at full difficulty.
evidence: Learner session, 13/11/2026
fix: Scale it to the learner's level (show the 3-number core for beginners), and offer 'read it, then compare with a colleague' via Share.
